summary: Phase phase-01 delivered all planned changes without deviation. The root typescript devDependency was bumped from ^6.0.3 to ^7 (resolving to 7.0.2), pnpm-lock.yaml was updated, docs/CONVENTIONS.md received a Toolchain section in the correct position, and README.md prerequisites were updated to TypeScript 7. All four planned files matched the reconciliation; no unplanned files were touched. The full gate passed with zero new TS7 diagnostics, excluded scope was fully respected, and the commit subject matches the plan exactly.

findings.message: Objective delivered as specified: typescript devDependency is ^7 in package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml resolves to 7.0.2, full gate passed with zero new diagnostics, no tsconfig or source changed.
No typecheck scripts, tsconfig files, or @typescript/native-preview / tsgo adoption introduced. ignoreDeprecations not added. Excluded scope fully respected.
All four planned files matched (package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, docs/CONVENTIONS.md, README.md); no unplanned files were touched. pnpm-lock.yaml change was listed as a planned edit.
No new tests planned or required. Full gate (including pnpm typecheck and pnpm test) passed, satisfying the test strategy.
Toolchain version boundary crossed correctly: tsc binary is now TypeScript 7.0.2, -b flag and tsconfig graph unchanged, pass verdict reproduced. No architectural boundary crossed.
Commit 917e831 subject 'build(deps): migrate the workspace to TypeScript 7' matches the planned commit subject exactly.

Handoff covers all required content: resolved version (7.0.2), confirmation all units type-check clean under TS7 with unchanged scripts/tsconfigs including project references, zero new diagnostics explicitly stated, doc locations with section descriptions, and no file-plan deviations noted. Handoff mentions four units instead of three (the plan was written before @steme-lab/steme was added); this is not a deviation.

attentionPoints: The handoff notes the README prerequisites were corrected from 'Node ≥ 22 / pnpm ≥ 9' to 'Node ≥ 24 / pnpm ≥ 10' as a fix for a pre-existing mismatch with package.json#engines. README.md was a planned edit so this is within scope, but reviewers may wish to confirm the engines field aligns with the updated prerequisites.
